deleteUsed: Sites still use this panel, so it can't be deleted
desc: Group links to the services you use into one start page. Add a Web service site of type “Navigation panel” to serve it; visitors on the LAN get LAN addresses automatically.
emptyHelp: Create a panel and add links, then add a Web service site of type “Navigation panel” that uses it. Open the site's domain to see the page.
iconHelp: Choose a built-in icon (Gately modules, common apps and more), or enter an emoji, short text (up to 8 characters) or an image URL (http/https), or upload an image. Leave empty to show the first letter of the name.
iconInline: The uploaded image is stored in the configuration ({size}). Clear it to use the default icon.
iconTextTooLong: Text icons can have up to 8 characters
iconTooLarge: The image is too large. Use one smaller than {size}, or enter an image URL instead
importEmpty: No sites to add: sites with wildcard domains and Close connection sites have no address
importNoPortHelp: Check this when the domains are reached on the default port (80/443) through router port mapping or an upstream proxy while the listener uses another port. You can also enter the public port under the listener's Access address, which corrects the links in the site list as well.
lanCidrsHelp: Visitors from these IPs or ranges also get LAN addresses, for example 100.64.0.0/10 for Tailscale. Loopback, private (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, fc00::/7) and link-local addresses always count as LAN.
lanUrlHelp: Visitors on the LAN open this address; when empty they use the address above too. Visitors can switch between LAN and internet in the top-right corner of the page.
name: Panel name
nameHelp: Only shown in the admin UI. The page shows it when the page title is empty.
noLinks: No links yet. Click “Add link” or add them from Web service sites.
previewHelp: The preview runs no scripts and has no search box; {'{host}'} expands to the admin UI's domain.
sameTab: Open in the same tab (new tab by default)
subtitle: Subtitle
skinHelp: The page's default colors, the same themes as the admin UI. Visitors can switch the theme (color scheme, light or dark mode, accent color and corner radius) from the top right of the page; the choice is saved in their browser and shared with the admin UI when both are on the same domain
title: Navigation panels
tooManyLinks: A panel can have up to {n} links
unused: No site uses this panel yet
urlInvalid: Enter a full URL, for example https://nas.example.com
varsHelp: Addresses can use variables: {'{host}'} is the domain the visitor used to open the panel, {'{STUN_web_PORT}'} and {'{STUN_web_ADDR}'} are a STUN rule's public port and address. A link whose variable has no value yet shows as unavailable.
unsupported: The Gately you're connected to doesn't support navigation panels (its backend is older and returns 404). Upgrade to a version that includes this feature.
iconBuiltin: Built-in icon: {name}. Change the background color below.
iconBuiltinMissing: This built-in icon doesn't exist in this version
altsHelp: Other entrances to the same service, such as IPv6, frp, STUN traversal or a Cloudflare tunnel. Visitors pick the default address or one of these from an address list, opened in a new tab; the list shows on click, or, when Layout is set to open directly, on right-click or long-press. Shown to both LAN and WAN visitors.
altNameRequired: Enter a name for each access method
lanDetectNote: LAN or internet is decided by the visitor's direct address: when internet visitors come in through frpc, cloudflared or a Docker port mapping on this machine, the direct address is this machine or a container network and they count as LAN. In that case enable the PROXY protocol on the listener or configure trusted proxies. Links' LAN addresses are visible to anyone who can open the panel (visitors can switch with ?net=lan); to keep them private, enable site authentication or IP access control.
moduleDisabled: The Web service module is turned off, so navigation panels are unavailable. Turn on the Web service module under Settings → Modules.
enginesHelp: The button on the left of the search box switches the search scope: “This page” only filters the links on the page; with a search engine selected, press Enter or click the button on the right to search with it in a new tab, while typing still filters the links. Visitors’ choice is remembered in their browser.
noEngines: No search engines yet; the search box only filters links on the page
engineNameRequired: Enter a name for the search engine
engineNeedQ: The search URL must contain {'{q}'} for the keyword
engineUrlInvalid: The search URL must start with http:// or https://
bgPlaceholder: Image URL (http/https) or upload an image
bgInline: The uploaded image is stored in the configuration ({size}); clear it to restore the default background.
bgHelp: Enter an image URL or upload an image (compressed automatically); leave empty for the default gradient background.
bgTooLarge: The image is still larger than {size} after compression; use another one or enter an image URL
bgDimHelp: A tint of the page colour laid over the image; higher values make text clearer.
authOnlyHelp: Visitors who are not signed in do not see this link (neither its name nor its address is sent). The site needs web authentication with “Require authentication only for paths marked Required below” checked, so signed-out visitors can open the panel and find the sign-in button; on sites that require sign-in for everything all visitors are already signed in.
authOnlyByGroup: The group “{name}” is visible only after sign-in, so this link follows it; click the lock icon on the group header to change that.
groupAuthOn: Make visible after sign-in: links in this group are shown only to signed-in visitors, including links added later
groupAuthOff: Make this group visible to everyone
tabTitleHelp: The title shown on the browser tab; the page title is used when empty.
faviconHelp: The small icon on the browser tab, written like the page icon (built-in icons are drawn on a colour tile); the page icon is used when empty.
pageDescHelp: Written to the page’s meta description and shown by search engines and share previews; not displayed on the page.
footerHelp: When the footer text is empty the Gately logo and name are shown; otherwise your text is shown, optionally linked to an http(s) URL.
styleCardDesc: Icon on the left, with name and description on the right.
styleAppDesc: Like desktop apps: a large icon with the name below and no description.
iconSizeHelp: Icon edge length; empty for the default (smaller on phones). Once set, desktop and phones both use it.
columnsHelp: How many links a row holds at most on wide screens; fewer as the window narrows. Counted in large cards for the card style, a small card takes half. Empty fills rows by width.
mobileColumnsHelp: How many links each row shows on phones (640 px wide or less); icons shrink when they do not fit.
maxWidthHelp: Maximum width of the page content; sets the side margins on wide screens.
layoutHelp: Visitors can also switch between cards and icons and change the icon size under Page settings at the top right; that is stored only in their browser. Switch between desktop and phone in Preview to check the result.
groupCountHelp: Show the number of links next to each group title.
altBadgeHelp: Links with other ways to open show their total number of addresses on the icon's top-right corner.
altClickChooserHelp: Clicking a link that has other ways to open shows the address list for visitors to pick from.
altClickDirectHelp: A click opens the address for the current network (LAN or WAN) right away; right-click on a computer or long-press on a phone to show the address list.
appNameHelp: Show the name under each icon in the app icon style, also when visitors switch to icons on the page. Names inside 1×2 wide tiles are always shown.
lockMarkHelp: Signed-in visitors see a lock on links that are visible only after sign-in; turn off to hide it. Visitors who are not signed in never see such links.
skinSwitchHelp: Show the theme button at the top right so visitors can pick colors and light or dark mode. When off, the page always uses the theme and mode set above, and choices visitors saved earlier no longer apply.
langSwitchHelp: Show a language menu at the top right. When off (the default), the page follows the visitor's browser language.
bgPreviewHelp: Blur and overlay update as you drag the sliders; see the Preview tab for the full page.
iconFetchHelp: Gately opens the link address (the LAN address first) and uses the icon the page declares, or /favicon.ico
iconFetchNoUrl: Enter an http/https link address first
iconSitesHelp: Opens in a new tab. Copy the image address of an icon and paste it into the icon field, or download it and click Upload.
iconTrimHelp: Crops transparent or solid-color margins around the image so the logo is centered and fills the icon. SVGs keep their vector content; only the view box changes. An image address is downloaded first and saved in the configuration.
iconTrim_blank: The image is blank; there is nothing to keep
iconTrim_mixed: The image corners have different colors, so the margin cannot be determined
iconTrim_none: The image has no extra margins
sizeHelp1x1: 1×1: icon only; the name shows on hover.
sizeHelp1x2App: 1×2: a wide tile with the icon on the left and the name and description on the right.
sizeHelp2x2: 2×2: a large block two rows high and two columns wide, with a bigger icon and the title and description below.
sizeHelp2x2App: 2×2: a big icon two rows high and two columns wide, with the name below.
selectHint: Drag the handle on the left to reorder. Drop on a group title to move to the end of that group. Check several links and drag any one of them to move them together
searchPlaceholder: Search name, title, group or note
